scripts-descriptions.test: Run all tests, or pass PHPUnit arguments after --.
scripts-descriptions.test:architecture: Run architecture checks; accepts PHPUnit arguments.
scripts-descriptions.test:api: Run native API contracts and scanner tests; accepts PHPUnit arguments.
scripts-descriptions.lint: Check PHP syntax without executing source; accepts focused paths.
scripts-descriptions.package: Build and validate the production archive; extra arguments are ignored.
scripts-descriptions.analyse:lib: Analyze all production classes at level 0; extra arguments are ignored.
scripts-descriptions.analyse:core: Analyze the defined core at level 5; extra arguments are ignored.
scripts-descriptions.analyse: Run both fixed static analysis scopes; extra arguments are ignored.
scripts-descriptions.check: Validate, lint, analyze, run PHP and JavaScript tests, and package; extra arguments are ignored.
scripts-descriptions.test:js: Build assets and run the complete JavaScript suite; extra arguments are ignored.
scripts-descriptions.assets:build: Build both production JavaScript entries; extra arguments are ignored.
scripts-descriptions.docs:check: Validate all repository documentation, links and provenance; fixed scope.
scripts-descriptions.docs:translations: Report translation freshness; missing/stale are advisory, invalid provenance fails.
scripts-descriptions.test:docs: Run all documentation tooling tests; fail on empty discovery.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run one pinned disposable native cell: -- [--plan] NC DB MODE; starts containers only without --plan.
scripts-descriptions.test:clients: Run private TLS/Inspector acceptance against an explicitly selected retained fixture; requires three absolute paths. No public exposure.
scripts-descriptions.test:clients:unit: Check the client acceptance runner safety boundaries without containers.
scripts-descriptions.test:clients:storage: Check pinned Inspector encrypted storage across issuers in isolated processes; requires its absolute installation path. No containers or network.
